description: Source code for an emulator of the generic eSPI Host in Zephyr OS, including virtual wire management, event triggering, and device instantiation.

methods.name: emul_host_init_vw_state
methods.description: Initializes virtual wire states to default values.

methods.name: emul_host_find_index
methods.description: Finds index of a virtual wire in the host data array.

methods.name: emul_host_set_vw
methods.description: Sets the level of a virtual wire if direction permits.

methods.name: emul_host_get_vw
methods.description: Gets the level of a virtual wire if direction permits.

methods.name: emul_espi_host_send_vw
methods.description: Sends a virtual wire signal from host to device, triggers event.

methods.name: emul_espi_host_port80_write
methods.description: Writes data to port 80, triggers debug event.

methods.name: emul_espi_host_get_acpi_shm
methods.description: Retrieves shared memory address for ACPI.

methods.name: emul_host_init
methods.description: Initializes a new eSPI host emulator instance.
